plain_english: From your waking, his waking; from your sleep, his sleep. Hence all is of your nature: the world as real and unreal.
sanskrit_cite: tvatprabodhāt prabodho'sya tvannidrāto layo'sya yat | atastvadātmakaṃ sarvaṃ viśva sadasadātmakam

plain_english: The tongue is tired of your name; the mind is tired of remembering you. For the formless, what meditation? For the qualityless, what name?
sanskrit_cite: jihvā śrāntā bhavannāmni manaḥ śrāntaṃ bhavatsmṛtau | arūpasya kuto dhyāna nirguṇasya ca nāma kim

plain_english: For the full, whence summoning? For the all-based, whence a seat? For the clean, foot-water and respects? For the pure, sipping?
sanskrit_cite: pūrṇasyāvāhanaṃ kutra sarvādhārasya cāsanam | svacchasya pādyamarghyañca śuddhasyācamanaṃ kutaḥ

plain_english: For the stainless, what bath? For the world-bellied, what garment? For the unanointed, what scent? For the lovely, what jewel?
sanskrit_cite: nirmalasya kutaḥ snānaṃ vastraṃ viśvodarasya ca | nirlepasya kuto gandho ramyasyābharaṇaṃ kutaḥ

plain_english: The sacred thread for the propless; flowers for the desireless. Incense for the noseless, lamp for the eyeless — what use?
sanskrit_cite: nirālambasyopavītaṃ puṣpaṃ nirvāsanasya ca | aghrāṇasya kuto dhūpaścakṣurhīnasya dīpakaḥ

plain_english: Food-offering for the ever-content, betel for the Lord — whence? Circumambulation for the endless, obeisance for the non-dual — whence?
sanskrit_cite: nityatṛptasya naivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca kuto vibhoḥ | pradakṣiṇamanantasyā'dvitīyasyaya kuto natiḥ

plain_english: Whence waving-lights for the self-shining Lord? How is a hymn enjoined for the Veda-unspeakable?
sanskrit_cite: svayaṃ prakāśamānasya kuto nīrājanaṃ vibhoḥ | vedavācāmavedyasya kutaḥ stotraṃ vidhīyate

plain_english: How is there sending-off for the full, inside and out? And how is there oblation for the difference-free, everywhere?
sanskrit_cite: antarbahiśca pūrṇasya kathamudvāsanaṃ bhavet | bhedahīnasya viśvatra kathaṃ ca havanaṃ bhavet

plain_english: Where is the fee for the full? Libation for the ever-content? Dismissal for the all-pervading? Pardon for the unseen?
sanskrit_cite: pūrṇasya dakṣiṇā kutra nityatṛptasya tarpaṇam | visarjanaṃ vyāpakasyā'pratyakṣasya kṣamāpaṇam

plain_english: Just so, indeed, is the highest worship, in all states, always: with nondual mind, yoke the mind to God as Lord of all.
sanskrit_cite: evameva parā pūjā sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā | aikyabuddhayā tu sarveśe mano deve niyojayet
